The function of genphy_read_status is that reading phy information
from HW and using these information to update SW variable. If user
is using ethtool to setting the speed of phy and service task is calling
by hclge_get_mac_phy_link
column2: the result of speed setting is uncertain.

column1: Because ethtool cmd will modified phydev and hclge_get_mac_phy_link also
will modified phydev.
Because phy state machine will update phy link periodically
just use phydev->link to check the link status. This patch removes
function call of genphy_read_status. To ensure accuracy
adds a phy state check. If phy state is not PHY_RUNNING
link is down. Because in some scenarios
but phy state is not PHY_RUNNING. This is just an intermediate state.
In fact
column2: the link is not ready yet.
